name: NES PPU master palette
source: https://lospec.com/palette-list/nintendo-entertainment-system (Lospec palette list, 'Nintendo Entertainment System' / NES 2C02 PPU master palette). Hex values were extracted directly from that page's HTML on 2026-10-27; nesdev.org/wiki/PPU_palettes documents the same hardware palette but was not directly cross-checked value-by-value here (its page only ships color swatches as an image and downloadable .pal files, not an inline hex table).
license: Public domain hardware palette (console color output, not copyrightable artwork). Safe for commercial use.
note: 55 colors. docs/architecture.md and format.md round this to 'about 54' because two near-identical whites (#fcfcfc/#f8f8f8) are usually reported as one; this file keeps both because the PPU exposes them as distinct palette indices.
